lines.t: I heard a whisper through the silence, calling out my name,
Words of mercy, words of fire, never sound the same.
Through the veil of world’s confusion, truth begins to rise,
Shining like the dawn of heaven breaking through my lies.
The voice in the volumes, echo in the storm,
Guides my heart through shadows, keeps my spirit warm.
From the scroll of ages, the promise calls me home,
The voice in the volumes says, “You’re not alone.”
Every prophecy unfolding like a flame in the dark,
Revealing all the hidden things that move within the heart.
A thousand questions fall away beneath the holy rain,
Where the Word becomes my shelter and my chains are slain.
The voice in the volumes, echo in the storm,
Guides my heart through shadows, keeps my spirit warm.
From the scroll of ages, the promise calls me home,
The voice in the volumes says, “You’re not alone.”
Now I walk between the thunder and the grace above,
With open eyes and trembling hands, I find unending love.
The truth became my anthem, my refuge and my flame,
In the pages of remembrance, He calls me by my name.
The voice in the volumes, holy and sublime,
Turning hearts to mercy, bending space and time.
The spirit moves eternal, the message carved in stone,
The voice in the volumes says, “You’re going home.”
